title: Defection/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "The scattered survivors of this Infestation have barricaded themselves in safe areas throughout the galleon. Escort the crew to the waiting escape ship."

- Lotus: "Don't be alarmed by the crew. They're Grineer defectors rescued by Steel Meridian but too broken to join their ranks. Instead they banded together in search of a more peaceful life. They call themselves Kavor."

- Lotus: "The crew here are Kavor defectors. Grineer who rejected the violence they were created for. Rather than join the Steel Meridian they've chosen a different path, seeking a dream of existence where they will not be forced to commit more atrocities."
- Lotus: "The Infestation is airborne and is slowly killing the crew. The med-boosters scattered throughout the ship are their only hope of survival."

- Lotus: "The galleon's atmosphere has become toxic. It will kill crew members within minutes. Their only hope is the med-boosters but you must keep them powered. The survivors will never reach the transport without them."
- Sargas Ruk: "Look what I found. The Kavor, the high and mighty dead fools walking."
- Sargas Ruk: "Kavor betrayed your post. Betrayed your comrades. Betrayed me. Your punishment: endless suffering!"
- Sargas Ruk: "Poor Kavor. The Tenno led me right to you."
- Sargas Ruk: "Kavor. Your the rest of a bad batch inflicted with that mutation. The Pacifism Defect. You should have been incinerated like the garbage you are!"
- Sargas Ruk: "You Kavor are a mistake. A factory malfunction. Your pacifism, nothing more than a defect."
- Lotus: "The first batch of survivors are beyond this door. Find them."
- Lotus: "I've located the first group of survivors. Find them and escort them to the waiting transport."
- Lotus: "Another group of defectors need an escort."
- Lotus: "I found a new group of survivors."
- Lotus: "There's another group of survivors looking for an escort."
- Lotus: "Survivors are trying to get to the transport. They aren't going to make it without your help."
- Stoic Defector: "Only death there. But death means peace. Let us go."
- Stoic Defector: "Trust Tenno skoom. No choice."
- Stoic Defector: "The Tenno? Why you help?"
- PTSD Defector: "Don't want to go anywhere."
- PTSD Defector: "Too loud. Too many noises."
- PTSD Defector: "Need quiet. You make them quiet?"
- Pacifist Defector: "Cressa Tal sent you? Let's go."
- Pacifist Defector: "A Tenno? What choice do we have?"
- Pacifist Defector: "Tenno? You won't kill me?"
- Lotus: "Let the survivors know you are ready to keep moving."
- Lotus: "Tell the survivors when you are ready to move on."
- Stoic Defector: "We got with you but we cannot fight like before."
- PTSD Defector: "Tenno show me the way."
- Pacifist Defector: "One. Two. Three. I can do this again!"
- Lotus: "The crew will die if you don't find power cells for the med-booster."
- Lotus: "This med-booster is the only thing keeping the crew alive. Make sure it doesn't run out of power."
- Lotus: "Find power cells and bring them to the med-booster to keep it operational."
- Lotus: "Find power cells for the med-booster."
- Lotus: "This med-booster is out of power."
- Lotus: "Get power cells in that med-booster, now!"
- Lotus: "The survivors are hurting. Keep the med-boosters powered to give them the relief they need."
- Lotus: "For the survivors, these med-boosters mean the difference between life and death. Keep them powered."
- Lotus: "The survivors need first-aid before they can move on. Find power cells for the med-booster."
- Stoic Defector: "Ratzan-narr, is there no rest?"
- Stoic Defector: "Infestation called us here, no lie."
- Stoic Defector: "Better not be a trap Tenno."
- Stoic Defector: "This again? Fight or die? Rraahudd"
- Stoic Defector: "They said Tenno kill us for sport. Did they lie?"
- Stoic Defector: "Tenno? Steel Meridian send you?"
- PTSD Defector: "We came to help, the distress call was a PRETAkkang trap."
- PTSD Defector: "Tenno get nightmares? I do."
- PTSD Defector: "Escape Grineer to die here? No!"
- PTSD Defector: "Eyes closed, there is only blood."
- Pacifist Defector: "The Infestation can think. It can hunt."
- Pacifist Defector: "Not the plan! Plan was no fighting."
- Pacifist Defector: "This ship, our dream... both dead."
- Pacifist Defector: "Look at me like that? You were made to kill too, Tenno."
- Pacifist Defector: "Said no more fighting. Rahm here we are!"
- Pacifist Defector: "These sikkhat monsters feel no pain. Right?"
- Pacifist Defector: "How, Tenno? How you kill so much?"
- Sargas Ruk: "Kavor wretches. Thought you were too good to be Grineer? But no Grineer would cower in this cesspool of genetic filth!"
- Sargas Ruk: "Pathetic. Wiggling like bait for the Infested. Let them rend your coward flesh a mercy compared to my judgment."
- Sargas Ruk: "Did I not birth you? Feed you? Give you enemies to conquer? Ingrates."
- Sargas Ruk: "You deserted to practice peace? I will bathe you in violence until you drown!"
- Sargas Ruk: "Delicate Kavor flowers say they saw too much? You have not seen anything yet!"
- Sargas Ruk: "Kavor with Tenno skoom? You betrayed your genes. You betrayed your Queens!"
- Sargas Ruk: "You were born of violence, you will die of violence! I command it!"
- Sargas Ruk: "You humiliate all Grineer! There is no higher crime."
- Sargas Ruk: "Tenno, you aid and abed these fugitives? You too will face judgment."
- Lotus: "A survivor has safely reached the ship."
- Lotus: "Crew member rescued. Keep it up."
- Lotus: "A group of survivors have escaped."
- Lotus: "Success. A group of crew members has reached the transport."
- Lotus: "Survivors have just reached the safety of our transport. Keep them coming"
- PTSD Defector: "Can't be real, can it?"
- Sargas Ruk: "I will never stop hunting you!"
- Sargas Ruk: "Your betrayal breathes fire into my soul! I will find you Kavor!"
- Sargas Ruk: "Not even the Tenno will keep you safe!"
- Sargas Ruk: "I will remember what you did here today Tenno."
- Lotus: "The Infested are carrying power cells."
- Lotus: "Kill those Infested to get your power cell."
- Lotus: "You may use this consle to send a signal that you want to the survivors to hurry."
- Lotus: "Use this comms console to rush out more survivors."
- Lotus: "Grineer manic. He's here to kill the defectors. Take him out."
- Stoic Defector: "Always knew Sargas would come!"
- PTSD Defector: "Manic, a manic is here to kill us."
- PTSD Defector: "It will kill us. Please, Tenno help."
- Pacifist Defector: "Ruk's manic assassin! We all dead!"
- Pacifist Defector: "Ruk will never let us go!"
- Sargas Ruk: "I have you now traitors!"
- Sargas Ruk: "Even the Tenno cannot save you!"
- Sargas Ruk: "You gave me no choice!"
- Sargas Ruk: "Too quick. Too much mercy."
- Lotus: "Careful Tenno. My scans show something big is coming your way."
- Lotus: "Stay alert. An unusually large organism as entered the area."
- Red Veil: "Kavor, you could be the key to a future of peace. You must be studied. Alas, Steel Meridian has denied our request for a specimen so now we are forced to take one. Stand aside Tenno."
- Red Veil: "What defect made you reject violence Kavor? Can we exploit it? Our questions need answers and our answers require a sacrifice. Do not interfere Tenno."
- Stoic Defector: "Red Veil, we never hurt them."
- Stoic Defector: "Red Veil as bad as Grineer."
- Stoic Defector: "We hate no one but they all want us death."
- PTSD Defector: "We make enemies everywhere. Why?"
- Pacifist Defector: "The more we try to change, the bigger target we become."
- Pacifist Defector: "Why do they hate our peace?"
- Red Veil: "We will learn much from this specimen."
- Red Veil: "Fear not Kavor. Your comrade's sacrifice will not be in vain."
- Red Veil: "A specimen! Kavor, consider your comrade's life a gift to the greater good."
- Stoic Defector: "The air is killing me."
- PTSD Defector: "Not going to make it."
- Stoic Defector: "The sikkhat is in me!"
- Stoic Defector: "I won't make it out."
- Stoic Defector: "Tenno! This is killing us!"
- Pacifist Defector: "Tenno! This is killing us!"
- Lotus: "A crew member is down. Heal them."
- Lotus: "Heal that crew member before they die."
- Stoic Defector: "Forget about me. Keep moving."
- PTSD Defector: "Gonna die. Gonna die. Gonna die."
- Stoic Defector: "You should have left me."
- Stoic Defector: "Death would have been easier."
- Lotus: "We've lost one. Keep crew members alive. Lose too many and I will be forced to abort the mission."
- Lotus: "Crew member killed. Protect the remaining survivors."
- Lotus: "Another crew member has been killed."
- Lotus: "Too many crew have died. This mission is a failure."
- Sargas Ruk: "Now it's my turn to round up the deserters."
- Sargas Ruk: "Look at that Kavor! The Tenno failed you, just as you failed me."
- Sargas Ruk: "Nothing will save you now Kavor."
- Lotus: "There are still survivors to be evacuated, but this operation is becoming increasingly risky. You have permission to seek extraction when you feel you can no longer protect the crew."
- Lotus: "The Infestation is growing more aggressive with each passing minute. Head to extraction when you can no longer guarantee the crew's safety."
- Lotus: "That's everyone. Let's get out of here."
- Lotus: "All crew members accounted for. Time to go."
**If minimum number of suvivors evacuated and too many crew members were killed**
- Lotus: "Too many crew members have been lost. We need to regroup. Head to extraction."
- Lotus: "You let too many of the crew to be killed. I can't allow this to continue. Head to extraction."
